blocks.text: We are finally here.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: Thirty-five instalments. Hundreds of Sanskrit passages. An alphabet that turned into a universe. A universe that turned out to be the self-manifestation of consciousness. A supreme Heart that was apparently present before we began searching for it.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: And now Abhinavagupta is going to do something even more extraordinary than explaining the metaphysics of Śiva.
blocks.directed: And now Abhinavagupta is going to do something even more extraordinary than explaining the metaphysics of Śiva.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: He's going to explain himself.
blocks.directed: He's going to explain himself.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: Not through another anonymous scriptural quotation, but through his own concluding verses.
blocks.directed: Not through another anonymous scriptural quotation, but through his own concluding verses.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: He will tell us where his ancestors came from, how his father understood the world, why he calls himself Abhinavagupta, whom he hopes to reach, and what he thinks of people who claim to be spiritual teachers without understanding what they're teaching.
blocks.directed: He will tell us where his ancestors came from, how his father understood the world, why he calls himself Abhinavagupta, whom he hopes to reach, and what he thinks of people who claim to be spiritual teachers without understanding what they're teaching.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: Spoiler: he is not impressed.
blocks.directed: Spoiler: he is not impressed.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: Then comes a confession. He himself has been misled by such teachers.
blocks.directed: Then comes a confession. He himself has been misled by such teachers.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: Then a revelation concerning the grace of Śiva and the teaching of Somānanda.
blocks.directed: Then a revelation concerning the grace of Śiva and the teaching of Somānanda.

blocks.section: “The Greatest Philosopher in Kashmir Has Had Enough of Fraud
blocks.text: And finally, after an enormous composition about divine language, Abhinavagupta asks the goddesses to forgive the restlessness of his speech and mind.

blocks.section: VI. Verse 16 - The Gurus Are Binding Everyone, So Abhinavagu
blocks.text: “Wandering in confusion themselves, those of feeble understanding lead the dull multitude of creatures astray. Making them their own, through the force of claims to virtue or attributed qualities, they bind them tightly with bonds. Seeing these bound creatures follow one another merely to carry the burdens of gurus, I fashioned the trident of knowledge to cut their fetters.”

blocks.section: X. Verse 20 - The Goddesses Return, Carrying a Trident That
blocks.text: “Ah! O goddesses, filled with overflowing bliss shining through the movements of the Heart's circle, you who are the keen upper edges of the trident of knowledge, skilled at breaking apart my countless bonds! Because this mind, speech, and body of mine-freed from the arising of fear of worldly becoming-have been properly threaded into you, come swiftly and powerfully into my heart with your grace!”

blocks.directed: Because, in his own metaphysics, every act of speech is a differentiated manifestation.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Language can express the supreme.
blocks.directed: Language can express the supreme.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: But no finite expression can exhaust the inexhaustible conscious ground.
blocks.directed: But no finite expression can exhaust the inexhaustible conscious ground.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: A sentence ends.
blocks.directed: A sentence ends.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The supreme Heart does not end with it.
blocks.directed: The supreme Heart does not end with it.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: A commentary can be completed.
blocks.directed: A commentary can be completed.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The reality it investigates is not thereby brought into existence.
blocks.directed: The reality it investigates is not thereby brought into existence.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: A philosopher can become silent.
blocks.directed: A philosopher can become silent.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Consciousness does not become absent because that philosopher has stopped speaking.
blocks.directed: Consciousness does not become absent because that philosopher has stopped speaking.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And so the final act is devotional.
blocks.directed: And so the final act is devotional.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The man who examined every phoneme offers his own words back to the goddesses.
blocks.directed: The man who examined every phoneme offers his own words back to the goddesses.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The man who investigated the nature of the subject offers his own mind.
blocks.directed: The man who investigated the nature of the subject offers his own mind.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The man who forged the trident of knowledge acknowledges the divine powers that make knowledge possible.
blocks.directed: The man who forged the trident of knowledge acknowledges the divine powers that make knowledge possible.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And the man who tried to free others from false teachers understands his own work as an expression of grace rather than a claim to independent supremacy.
blocks.directed: And the man who tried to free others from false teachers understands his own work as an expression of grace rather than a claim to independent supremacy.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: That is the extraordinary coherence of the ending.
blocks.directed: That is the extraordinary coherence of the ending.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The metaphysics is not abandoned.
blocks.directed: The metaphysics is not abandoned.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: It is lived within the authorial act.
blocks.directed: It is lived within the authorial act.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: One last image
blocks.directed: One last image

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Imagine Abhinavagupta finishing the manuscript.
blocks.directed: Imagine Abhinavagupta finishing the manuscript.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The final verse written.
blocks.directed: The final verse written.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The Sanskrit complete.
blocks.directed: The Sanskrit complete.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The difficult explanations over.
blocks.directed: The difficult explanations over.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The names of his companions recorded.
blocks.directed: The names of his companions recorded.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: His father's lineage preserved.
blocks.directed: His father's lineage preserved.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: His criticism of ignorant teachers delivered.
blocks.directed: His criticism of ignorant teachers delivered.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The trident of knowledge forged.
blocks.directed: The trident of knowledge forged.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The goddesses invoked.
blocks.directed: The goddesses invoked.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And the final request made:
blocks.directed: [short pause] And the final request made:

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: क्षमध्वम्।
blocks.directed: [slowly] क्षमध्वम्।

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Kṣamadhvam.
blocks.directed: [slowly] Kṣamadhvam.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Forgive.
blocks.directed: Forgive.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Now the room is quiet.
blocks.directed: Now the room is quiet.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: No more compounds.
blocks.directed: No more compounds.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: No more phonemes.
blocks.directed: No more phonemes.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: No more metrical calculations.
blocks.directed: No more metrical calculations.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: No more arguments about the nature of the knowing subject.
blocks.directed: No more arguments about the nature of the knowing subject.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The manuscript lies before him.
blocks.directed: The manuscript lies before him.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: A finite composition.
blocks.directed: A finite composition.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Written with a particular hand.
blocks.directed: Written with a particular hand.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: In a particular place.
blocks.directed: In a particular place.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: At a particular historical moment.
blocks.directed: At a particular historical moment.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And yet its subject was the reality that Abhinavagupta believed to be beyond spatial and temporal limitation.
blocks.directed: And yet its subject was the reality that Abhinavagupta believed to be beyond spatial and temporal limitation.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The supreme Heart.
blocks.directed: The supreme Heart.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The self-manifesting consciousness through which every form of experience appears.
blocks.directed: The self-manifesting consciousness through which every form of experience appears.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The awareness in which the act of writing was known.
blocks.directed: The awareness in which the act of writing was known.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The awareness in which the words were understood.
blocks.directed: The awareness in which the words were understood.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The awareness in which the reader's questions would eventually arise.
blocks.directed: The awareness in which the reader's questions would eventually arise.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And the awareness in which the entire philosophical enquiry would unfold.
blocks.directed: And the awareness in which the entire philosophical enquiry would unfold.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The commentary has ended.
blocks.directed: The commentary has ended.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The questions can continue.
blocks.directed: The questions can continue.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Because a finite explanation is not the same thing as the infinite reality it attempts to make intelligible.
blocks.directed: Because a finite explanation is not the same thing as the infinite reality it attempts to make intelligible.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And the most profound result of the work is not that the reader has acquired a collection of impressive Sanskrit doctrines.
blocks.directed: And the most profound result of the work is not that the reader has acquired a collection of impressive Sanskrit doctrines.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: It is the possibility of examining the very nature of the consciousness through which those doctrines are understood.
blocks.directed: It is the possibility of examining the very nature of the consciousness through which those doctrines are understood.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: That is the point.
blocks.directed: That is the point.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Not merely to know about Śiva.
blocks.directed: Not merely to know about Śiva.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Not merely to repeat a mantra.
blocks.directed: Not merely to repeat a mantra.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Not merely to perform an initiation.
blocks.directed: Not merely to perform an initiation.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Not merely to attain a special state.
blocks.directed: Not merely to attain a special state.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: But to recognise what, in Abhinavagupta's system, is the ultimate reality of the subject and the world.
blocks.directed: But to recognise what, in Abhinavagupta's system, is the ultimate reality of the subject and the world.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And if that recognition occurs, the entire universe is no longer understood as a second reality fundamentally alien to consciousness.
blocks.directed: And if that recognition occurs, the entire universe is no longer understood as a second reality fundamentally alien to consciousness.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: It becomes intelligible as the expression of Śiva's freedom.
blocks.directed: It becomes intelligible as the expression of Śiva's freedom.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The sound.
blocks.directed: The sound.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The thought.
blocks.directed: The thought.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The body.
blocks.directed: The body.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The world.
blocks.directed: The world.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The teacher.
blocks.directed: The teacher.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The student.
blocks.directed: The student.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The words.
blocks.directed: The words.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The silence.
blocks.directed: The silence.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: All manifest within the same conscious ground.
blocks.directed: All manifest within the same conscious ground.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And then the greatest philosophical joke of all becomes apparent.
blocks.directed: And then the greatest philosophical joke of all becomes apparent.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: We have spent thirty-six instalments investigating the supreme consciousness.
blocks.directed: We have spent thirty-six instalments investigating the supreme consciousness.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: We've travelled through the Sanskrit alphabet.
blocks.directed: We've travelled through the Sanskrit alphabet.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: We've examined the thirty-six tattvas.
blocks.directed: We've examined the thirty-six tattvas.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: We've studied initiation, ritual, death, liberation, mantra, desire, and the cosmic powers of Śakti.
blocks.directed: We've studied initiation, ritual, death, liberation, mantra, desire, and the cosmic powers of Śakti.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: We've confronted the relation between the limited self and the universal subject.
blocks.directed: We've confronted the relation between the limited self and the universal subject.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: We've watched Abhinavagupta dismantle the authority of incompetent teachers with an intellectual trident.
blocks.directed: We've watched Abhinavagupta dismantle the authority of incompetent teachers with an intellectual trident.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And now, finally, we reach the end.
blocks.directed: And now, finally, we reach the end.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Only to discover that the very reality we were studying was, according to the philosophy, already the condition of our studying it.
blocks.directed: Only to discover that the very reality we were studying was, according to the philosophy, already the condition of our studying it.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The question was manifested within consciousness.
blocks.directed: The question was manifested within consciousness.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The enquiry occurred within consciousness.
blocks.directed: The enquiry occurred within consciousness.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The understanding appeared within consciousness.
blocks.directed: The understanding appeared within consciousness.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And the supreme consciousness was not manufactured by any of them.
blocks.directed: And the supreme consciousness was not manufactured by any of them.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: So the last question is no longer:
blocks.directed: [short pause] So the last question is no longer:

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: “Where can I find Śiva?”
blocks.directed: [short pause] “Where can I find Śiva?”

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: It is:
blocks.directed: [short pause] It is:

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: What is the ultimate nature of the awareness through which the very question appears?
blocks.directed: What is the ultimate nature of the awareness through which the very question appears?

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: That is the enquiry Abhinavagupta leaves us with.
blocks.directed: That is the enquiry Abhinavagupta leaves us with.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And that is why the book ends not with a new object to acquire, but with the recognition of the reality in which all acquiring and seeking occur.
blocks.directed: And that is why the book ends not with a new object to acquire, but with the recognition of the reality in which all acquiring and seeking occur.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The universe has not become Śiva.
blocks.directed: The universe has not become Śiva.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The ultimate nature of the universe has been recognised as Śiva-consciousness.
blocks.directed: The ultimate nature of the universe has been recognised as Śiva-consciousness.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: And the final Sanskrit word is no longer something we need to invent.
blocks.directed: And the final Sanskrit word is no longer something we need to invent.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta has already given it to us.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta has already given it to us.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: क्षमध्वम् - kṣamadhvam.
blocks.directed: [slowly] क्षमध्वम् - kṣamadhvam.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: Forgive.
blocks.directed: Forgive.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The book is finished.
blocks.directed: The book is finished.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: The Heart, he says, is ever manifest.
blocks.directed: The Heart, he says, is ever manifest.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: इति शिवम्। - iti śivam.
blocks.directed: [slowly] इति शिवम्। - iti śivam.

blocks.section: XV. The final word: The bee, the trident, and the goddesses
blocks.text: End of Part XXXVI - the twenty-one authorial epilogue verses, the transmitted colophon, and the conclusion of our Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa audiobook.
blocks.directed: End of Part Thirty-Six - the twenty-one authorial epilogue verses, the transmitted colophon, and the conclusion of our Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa audiobook.
